tiers.name: Flat 4,096-Rank Direct TCPStore Polling + Unclean SIGTERM (Orphaned CUDA Contexts)
tiers.note: All 4,096 workers hammer single-threaded Rank-0 TCPStore (SYN backlog drop + 420s timeout), and zombie subprocesses hold HBM causing OOM on respawn!

tiers.name: External etcd Rendezvous Backend + Full 4,096-Process Cold Respawn (No Zombie Reap)
tiers.note: Avoids Rank-0 TCPStore bottleneck, but killing & cold-restarting all 4,096 Python/CUDA contexts wastes 165s and still hits DataLoader zombie OOMs!

tiers.name: 512-Node Agent Hierarchical Rendezvous + cgroup/PDEATHSIG Clean Respawn
tiers.note: Aggregates rdzv per node (512 agents instead of 4,096 ranks) and atomically reaps process trees before respawn (0% OOM, 38.0s recovery).

tiers.name: In-Process PG Abort + Hierarchical Store + Zero-Respawn Warm Reconfiguration
tiers.note: Survivors keep Python & CUDA contexts alive, abort stuck NCCL comm via async watchdog, and rebuild topology in 6.8s (61.8x faster recovery)!
